title: schima wallichii subsp. noronhae
intro: Schima wallichii subsp. noronhae, commonly known as the Schima plant or Malabar nut, is a plant species native to Asia and is used in traditional medicine. The Schima plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against diseases such as diabetes, cancer, and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of the Schima plant include its ability to act as an anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of the Schima plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
